title: Minimax Precision for Conditional Upper-Quantile Comparisons across a Design-Information Transition
banked_reason: D0.5 BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: sound math (pass, no findings), achieved subfield versus field floor; paper_score_ceiling 6.7 < 7.4; salvageable=false. Independent Codex-validity-gate confirms downgraded stop.
gap_reasons: The supplied proofs establish matched absolute-risk and honest-length orders over the declared class, but their applicability requires known tail powers, exact affine loading, known power-design density, fair assignment, and public smoothness. Beyond the explicitly inherited, unpublished alpha=1 sibling, the contribution is the cross-critical transition with joint nuisance estimation and full-record converses; the contraction step is classical and covered by [Duchi, Theorem 7](https://ai.stanford.edu/~jduchi/projects/probability_bounds.pdf). The 'prospectively usable' precision-certificate language exceeds the demonstrated quantitative value: C_up=2^40 makes the certified interval uninformative at ordinary sample sizes, and no informative finite-sample example is delivered. The Gram/root diagnostics check mathematical quantities rather than estimator performance, and the wage connection remains prospective. The 'Honest scope' claims that the frontier, attainment, converses, and every formal statement remain unproved are stale and contradict the proofs actually supplied; they do not identify an outstanding load-bearing conjecture. Narrow applicability and the absence of demonstrated useful finite-sample precision constrain the projected journal score, while inaccessible final comparator supplements remain source-verification items rather than evidence of priority. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.7 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: D0 supplied matched original-record absolute-risk and connected-honesty frontiers, the moving-design alpha=2 transition, joint nuisance-slope profiling, and full-record converses; the math referee passed with no findings. D0.5.G capped the sound result at subfield (6.7 versus field threshold 7.4), with no bounded in-scope salvage; independent terminal review agreed. The run stopped before F1, so no Lean formalization or kernel verification was attempted; the duplicate critical-information theorem and stale Honest scope prose remain disclosed editorial debt.
tldr: A profile-specific causal upper-quantile comparison can depend on a slowly diverging layer even when a heavier layer dominates the interior. The maintained power design varies how much covariate mass reaches the face. The research kernel determines finite optimal absolute risk and honest connected-interval length for the entire two-layer conditional-quantile class, locates the design-information transition, and retains both unknown layer coefficients in a feasible regression. The specific design-normalized near-face count provides an observable comparison. The uniform-design point-estimation and honesty result is inherited; novelty rests on a uniformly evaluated transition and its original-record attainment and converse.
gap: Fixed-interior efficient quantile regression, common-tail extremal regression limits, and scalar honest-tail inference do not determine finite whole-class causal precision when distinct quantile powers share an unknown affine loading and the face design mass changes.
fill: The finite whole-box contrast certificate links public weighted regression to a full-observation lower experiment. An explicit public frontier must evaluate moving designs, profiles, saturation, and count-method loss without changing the maintained class.
